thread:
nina-ops: Hi payroll — I just noticed my June 15 paycheck deducted both US FICA and Canadian CPP/EI. I moved to Toronto on June 10 and expected only Canadian deductions. Net pay is much lower.
payroll-us: Sorry about that, Nina. Can you DM your redacted stub?
payroll-canada: We see two rows processed for the mid-month period. Looks like termination/ residency flags weren't aligned between systems before the run.
hr-relocations: Relocation ticket shows notice on June 9 and Workday location updated June 10. Looks like termination event wasn't pushed to US payroll export.
payroll-bot: Ticket created: PR-11011 "Mid-month relocation double-deduction: nina-ops". Assigned to payroll ops.
payroll-us: Operational fix: we'll request reversal of duplicate FICA on next US provider submission and prepare a net top-up gross-up on July payroll if refunds are delayed.
payroll-canada: We'll pause further Canadian deductions until flags are reconciled, and prepare corrected XMLs for CRA/IRS.
hr-relocations: I'll add an interim checklist to ensure payroll termination is created before any cross-border run for mid-month movers.
nina-ops: Appreciate the quick response. Please confirm whether my W-2/T4 will be adjusted.
payroll-us: Yes — corrected reporting will be filed and year-end forms updated; we'll share documentation for tax advisors.
payroll-bot: PR-11011 updated: finance approval requested for one-time net make-whole. ETA 48 hrs."
